name: sdkman-cli
description: Self-update is bare curl|bash; candidate checksums are off by default and same-endpoint when enabled.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: Self-update streams the HTTPS response directly to bash without checksum or signature verification; insecure TLS is an opt-in setting.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.

original_evidence.text: | sdkman-cli | https://github.com/sdkman/sdkman-cli.git | f02e5de / 2026-08-05 | Y | N | Y | https by default; opt-in `sdkman_insecure_ssl=true` config adds `curl --insecure` to every SDKMAN network call | N | Self-update: **none** (curl-pipe-to-bash). Candidate install: **hash**, but **disabled by default** and sourced from the *same* broker response as the download itself | server-supplied/unpinned (same endpoint); self-update path has no key/hash at all | `sdkman-cli/src/main/bash/sdkman-selfupdate.sh:51,53` — `__sdkman_secure_curl "${SDKMAN_CANDIDATES_API}/selfupdate/.../${SDKMAN_PLATFORM}" \| bash` — no checksum/signature on the self-update payload at all, straight pipe-to-bash; `sdkman-cli/src/main/bash/sdkman-utils.sh:25-31` `__sdkman_secure_curl` adds `--insecure` when `sdkman_insecure_ssl=true`; `sdkman-cli/src/main/bash/sdkman-install.sh:141-157` downloads candidate binary then `__sdkman_checksum_zip`; `:191-195` `if [[ "$sdkman_checksum_enable" != "true" ]]; then ... skipping verification` — no default value for `sdkman_checksum_enable` found anywhere in the repo, so checksum verification is **off unless explicitly enabled**; `:205-233` when enabled, checksum is read from `X-Sdkman-Checksum-*` HTTP response headers of the *same* download (`:141-143`), i.e. same-endpoint, not independently signed. |
